chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a burgundy velvet djellaba with gold trim and a cream headscarf
chars.SON: SON: a young Moroccan man about 30 wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.BAKER: BAKER: a young Moroccan woman wearing a white baker's apron over a teal long-sleeve top and a white cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a traditional Moroccan living room (salon with long patterned sofas, zellige tiles, brass tea tray). MOM stands blocking SON, who has just walked in the front door with his keys still in hand; she points an angry finger at his face, mouth wide open shouting, he freezes with raised eyebrows. Seen from the hallway doorway, both faces visible, subjects in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon. MOM leans toward SON shaking both hands in the air in furious scolding; SON sits on the edge of the long sofa with his head lowered, guilty. Brass tea tray on a low round table. Subjects centred, medium shot.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon. MOM sits on the sofa with one hand on her chest and the other on her cheek, eyes worried and frightened, still talking; SON stands in front of her rubbing the back of his neck, lost for words. A wall clock behind them. Subjects centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan neighbourhood bakery: wooden shelves of round khobz bread loaves and msemen, a glass counter. BAKER stands behind the counter with crossed arms, sour proud expression, staring out at the street. Warm morning light. Subject centred, head-to-waist.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Moroccan street outside a small bakery. SON walks past on the pavement carrying a plastic bag; BAKER stands in the bakery doorway glaring at him with narrowed eyes and a sneer; SON glances sideways, uneasy. Both faces visible, subjects centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. SON bends down and kisses the top of MOM's headscarf to apologise, holding her hand; MOM sits on the sofa with her eyes closed, still upset but softening. Close medium shot, both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. SON sits beside MOM on the sofa, opening his hands as if trying to explain; MOM turns her face away with her hand raised to stop him. Tea glasses on the low table. Subjects centred.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SON alone at night on a Moroccan rooftop terrace with laundry lines and satellite dishes, sitting on a plastic chair, elbows on knees, looking down regretful. City lights of a Moroccan town in the background. Subject centred.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon in daylight. MOM sits close to SON on the sofa, smiling widely and holding up her smartphone to show him a photo of a young woman (the screen shows only a small blurry picture, no text); SON leans back surprised with wide eyes. Mint tea on the table. Subjects centred, faces visible.
